name: Taste
source:
Waking up in a strange room with a man holding a knife staring at you is bad enough, but he offers you food. The meat is flesh; he tells you it's human, but every part of your mind refuses to believe his words. Something strange is going on and he is terrible at explaining things.

[From [url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/taste]Itch.io[/url]]
